newsitem.title: ITALY: What if Santa is gay, asks Italian group.
newsitem.headline: What if Santa is gay, asks Italian group.

text.p: An Italian gay group on Wednesday picked Santa to star in a public relations campaign to stop discrimination against homosexuals.

"What if Santa were gay?" ran the slogan of a Christmas effort by the group Pride-Arcigay in the central city of Pisa to encourage greater acceptance of and respect for the estimated five percent of Italy's 57 million people who are homosexual.
A spokesman said a member of the group, the local branch of Italy's biggest gay rights organisation, would dress up as Santa and distribute leaflets in downtown Pisa on Thursday.
"In fact, not only Father Christmas but also your friend, your colleague, the barman who makes your coffee in the morning and your son, could be gay," the group said.
